items.title: Bind causal evidence version to the executing CLI across project layouts
items.context: Use the same version constant as CLI --version; prove missing and unrelated target manifests cannot alter tool identity.
items.userSees: External-project verification records the actual executing CLI version.

happy.desc: The built causal-evidence smoke proves external-project resolution returns the compiled CLI version and signed execution identity persists that same version.

edge.desc: The built causal-evidence smoke proves missing and malformed target-project and current-directory packages/main/package.json never omit or change the executing CLI version.

adversarial.desc: The built causal-evidence smoke proves unrelated business manifests, including conflicting target and cwd versions, cannot replace the executing CLI version.
